Title: Azure Database Migration Service: March update

Body.Content:
The latest update to the public preview of Azure Database Migration Service includes support for on-premises migrations from SQL Server to Azure SQL Database Managed Instance.

Azure Database Migration Service reduces the complexity of cloud migrations via the use of a single, comprehensive service. The service supports migrations of homogeneous/heterogeneous source-target pairs. The guided migration process is easy to understand and implement.

For more information about this update, see the blog post.
